name: Bayou Big Cubes 2024

information:
This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/).

Make sure to check out [Louisiana Speedcubing's Facebook group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1025679060833637) for upcoming competitions and announcements!

To learn more about Cubing in the US South, including other competitions, visit www.southerncubing.com.

- Please review the [competitor information] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BayouBigCubes2024#35056-competitor-information) tab before the competition.
- Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition.

Please note that the [schedule] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BayouBigCubes2024#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule
